visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside an Emirates business class cabin, the camera pans across luxurious seats with wood-grain finishes. (2) A close-up shows a large touch-screen tablet displaying a movie selection menu with films like 'Mickey 17' and 'Dune'. (3) A hand interacts with the tablet and then docks it into a dedicated side slot next to the seat. (4) The scene shifts to the on-board bar area where female flight attendants in tan uniforms and red hats stand behind a curved yellow-lit counter. (5) A male bartender pours a bright yellow cocktail into a glass. (6) A hand picks up a small bag of M&M's from a basket filled with various snacks like Keogh's chips. (7) A person's feet, wearing light blue slippers, are shown resting on the footwell of the airplane seat. (8) A grey drawstring bag with a 'Loungewear' graphic and a hoodie illustration is presented. (9) A hand fluffs a white pillow on a fully reclined airplane seat that has been converted into a bed with white linens. (10) The cabin ceiling is shown with small, sparkling blue lights arranged to look like a starry night sky. (11) The camera moves to a spacious airport lounge with many small tables, chairs, and people dining or waiting. (12) A glass display case in the lounge is shown, filled with small desserts, tarts, and bowls of fruit. (13) A chauffeur in a blue suit loads suitcases onto a luggage cart in an outdoor parking area. (14) The final shots show a passenger's legs inside a luxury van, passing bags including a white tote and a Louis Vuitton bag, while traveling on a highway.
